name: ocr97_night_3_dense_text_multicolumn
description: Night 3: Dense government text and multi-section long-form reports. Tests native PDF text extraction vs MinerU2.5 on text-heavy digital PDFs, Surya column detection on two-column layouts, and handling of multi-section/multi-district narrative reports. Exposes quality degradation on longer unstructured text.

documents.title: Federal Reserve Beige Book, November 2024
documents.goal: Extract multi-section regional economic narrative from a Beige Book report covering all 12 Federal Reserve Districts. Tests handling of dense sectioned text, district headings, and economic condition summaries.

documents.title: Federal Reserve Beige Book, April 2025
documents.goal: Extract multi-section regional economic summary covering all Federal Reserve Districts. This run provides a second Beige Book instance to test consistency of multi-section text extraction across different content.

documents.title: IRS Publication 550 — Investment Income and Expenses
documents.goal: Extract a dense multi-chapter investment taxation guide with tables, examples, cross-references, and definitions. Tests extraction from a very long (100+ page) mixed-layout document across the first 5 pages covering dividends, interest, and capital gains definitions.

documents.title: IRS Form 1040 Instructions (2024)
documents.goal: Extract the general instructions booklet for Form 1040 — a dense two-column layout with tables, line-by-line instructions, tax brackets, and cross-references. Tests column detection and dense tabular instruction extraction.
